body.statement: Let \(r=\min\{d+1,n-1\}\). If \(s\ge r\), then \(N^{\star}(n,K,d,\tau,s)\le F(n,r,s)\le U_{\mathrm{PB}}(n,r,s)\). The decoder retains \(a\to t\) exactly when every cover row \(I\) with \(a\in I\) and \(t\notin I\) has \(t\in D_I(a)\); for every nonedge \(a\to t\), the cover contains such a row that also targets an \(r\)-set extending \(\{a\}\cup\operatorname{pa}_{\cup}(t)\).
body.justification: This is an explicit non-CADIM upper design that exploits last-parent blocking and works without knowing the union skeleton.
body.gap: CADIM scans ancestor layers with at most quadratic count, while single-DAG separating systems separate endpoints and do not enforce simultaneous parent blockers.
body.consumer: The bound supplies a concrete bounded-panel schedule whenever the exact adaptive frontier is computationally unavailable.
